sections.title: **INVESTIGATION:     ULTRASOUND WHOLE ABDOMEN**
sections.text:
**_===============================================================_** 

**Liver: is enlarged in size (~15.8cm),** normal in outline and **shows diffusely increased in parenchymal echogenicity and obscuring periportal echogenecity S/O Grade-II fatty liver** . No focal lesion is seen. No intrahepatic biliary dilatation seen. Hepatic veins are normal. Portal vein is normal. 

**Gall bladder** : Well distended. No e/o any calculus / mass seen in its lumen **.** No e/o any GB wall thickening or pericholecystic collection. Proximal CBD is normal in caliber. 

**Pancreas:** is normal (head and body) in bulk and echogenicity, tail is obscured due to overlying bowel gases. MPD is not dilated. 

**Spleen:** is normal in size (~11cm), outline and echogenicity. No focal lesion seen. 

**Right kidney:** is normal in size (~9.1cm), shape and outline **with mildly increased cortical echogenicity.** Corticomedullary differentiation is maintained.  No calculus or hydronephrosis is seen. 

**Left kidney:** is normal in size (~11cm), shape and outline **with mildly increased cortical echogenicity.** Corticomedullary differentiation is maintained. No calculus or hydronephrosis is seen. 

**Urinary Bladder:** is well distended and shows normal wall thickness and anechoic lumen. 

**Prostate:** is normal in size (Vol~22cc), shape and echotexture. No lymphadenopathy / free fluid seen. Bowel loops are normal in calibre.

sections.title: **IMPRESSION:**
sections.text:
- **Hepatomegaly with Grade II fatty liver. (Adv: CBC, LFT, Lipid Profile & Viral Markers).** 

- **B/L mildly increased renal cortical echogenicity-likely age related changes.** **<u>(Adv: RFT & Urine R/E).</u>** 

Please correlate clinically and with other relevant investigations.
